invented_facts: The battery test used 8B inference; the paper does not specify the model used for that test.
Larger models require the 128 GB configuration; the tested 30B model also ran on the 32 GB and 64 GB configurations.
notes: The summary fits the VP audience and requested format, but omits required caveats: only one Vantage configuration was tested; models were 4-bit quantized and output quality was not evaluated; and the video-playback rating was measured at 150 nits. It also leaves out several test conditions, including AC power for non-battery tests and Wi-Fi being off for the battery rating.
